title: social_inbox_wait result
description: Output (structuredContent) of the social_inbox_wait MCP tool. See RFC-0007 § social_inbox_wait.

next_event_id.description: Cursor to pass as last_event_id on the next call. Null only when the tenant has never had an event. Opaque to clients.

event_id.description: Opaque per-tenant identifier. Byte-identical to the event_id the same event carries via notifications/shadownet/* transports.

data.description: Payload for this event type. See RFC-0007 § Events.
